S2_race_two_cashiers_same_order.scenario: Two cashiers tap 'Encaisser' on same kiosk-cash row simultaneously
S2_race_two_cashiers_same_order.protection: K2-HEAL-01 — PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment wraps in DB::transaction, acquires lockForUpdate, then post-acquire re-checks payment_status. Cashier A wins lock + flips PAID + writes audit_logs row. Cashier B enters and queries audit_logs for collector identity. If same user → 200 no-op (V5.5 sister-guard for double-tap). If different user → throws PaymentAlreadyCollectedException → route closure catches BEFORE generic 422 → 409 with structured payload {error_code: 'payment_already_collected', collected_by_user_id, collected_at}. Modal `onConfirm` matches code and surfaces FR error toast + emits cancel.
S2_race_two_cashiers_same_order.verdict: PROTECTED — triple-defense (Cache::lock → DB::transaction → lockForUpdate → audit_logs SoT)
S2_race_two_cashiers_same_order.evidence: PaymentService.php:227-310 code annotations + code structure verified
S2_race_two_cashiers_same_order.caveat: Could not reproduce live race (single-browser test). Cited audit references: `C5_EncaisserKdsPreserveTest:302-355` (sister-guard pattern) and Phase J adversarial round.

S4_nf525_composition_snapshot_integrity.scenario: Mid-flight order mutation tries to overwrite composition_snapshot
S4_nf525_composition_snapshot_integrity.protection: PricingService.php:266-291 writes composition_snapshot ONLY in order creation transaction; CompositionSnapshotBuilder.php:14 documents 'NF525 immutability contract — must NEVER be re-written'. There is no setter exposed. Mirror order on refund creates a FRESH snapshot from parent, parent's stays untouched.
S4_nf525_composition_snapshot_integrity.verdict: PROTECTED — by design, no code path to mutate

S5_nf525_fiscal_sequence_monotonic.scenario: Concurrent fiscal_sequence_no allocation under load (50+/s rush)
S5_nf525_fiscal_sequence_monotonic.protection: FiscalSequenceService::next() triple-defense: Cache::lock(5s) per-branch + DB::transaction + MAX(fiscal_sequence_no) INCLUDING soft-deleted (line 89-90) → strictly monotonic + gap-free. Allocation point: at order creation (kiosk paid) OR close (POS cash). On alloc fail, sets fiscal_alloc_error_at flag + retry cron — no silent gap.
S5_nf525_fiscal_sequence_monotonic.verdict: PROTECTED — triple-defense documented in FiscalSequenceService.php:14-90; CLAUDE.md §8 verified

S6_refund_double_submission_idempotency.scenario: Cashier double-taps the Confirm refund button OR retries with different X-Idempotency-Key after a 500
S6_refund_double_submission_idempotency.protection: Frontend: PosRefundModal idempotency key MINTED on modal mount = pos-refund-{orderId}-{ts}, frozen across double-clicks within session (line 287). Same key = same modal session = IdempotencyKeyMiddleware 2xx replay cache hits. Different timestamps (new modal opening) = different keys = backend UNIQUE(parent_order_id) constraint catches → 23000 SQL state → 409 MIRROR_ALREADY_EXISTS → frontend onConfirm matches code === 'MIRROR_ALREADY_EXISTS' → info toast 'pos.refund.already_refunded' + emit refunded({alreadyRefunded: true}).
S6_refund_double_submission_idempotency.verdict: PROTECTED — triple-defense (idempotency middleware + UNIQUE constraint + frontend code branch)
